verdict.rationale: Box documents a free developer account with a developer token for making first API calls (box-docs-31, box-docs-17). That gives a separate account where an AI-native user could experiment apart from their organization's real content. However, nothing describes it as a sandbox or guarantees isolation from production data. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented sandbox environment, isolation guarantees from production enterprise data, seeding or reset of test data, and hands-on corroboration.
